occurrence.create.meaning: creates occurrence and empty shot closure

shot.set.meaning: writes only shot payload name/settings; no item insertion

occurrence.add-media.meaning: preserves existing shot item while creating an occurrence clip and registry binding

placement.create.meaning: creates an occurrence-owned clip and registry binding

placement.unplace.meaning: removes an occurrence-owned clip while guarding its binding

rejected_equivalent.change: empty semantic-born shot -> authored shot containing item-1

conclusion: No registered public semantic command faithfully creates the authored item from the empty semantic birth. The existing refusal is correct; no source migration was applied.
